anti_conflation_invariants: Evidence-only or value changes may preserve record_id but must change measurement_digest.
A specification-version change must change the affected record_id.
A path-only relocation must change neither record_id nor measurement_digest.
record_id alone must not be used as a content hash or global identifier.

measurement_digest.role: content identity for the deterministic measurement result

record_id.comparison_scope: within a declared result or together with measurement_digest
record_id.role: stable observation-slot identity within one measurement result
